words.sense: Present as hidden or undeveloped potential, not yet outwardly expressed.
misconceptions: Calling undeveloped talent a paused operation.
Missing evidence that an activity already existed and could resume.

words.sense: Temporarily inactive after being active, but capable of restarting.
misconceptions: Assuming all inactivity means an earlier activity stopped.
Missing evidence that an activity already existed and could resume.

chains.frame: Which word best describes Yara’s musical ability?

beats.text: Yara could repeat complex rhythms by ear, but had never learned an instrument or performed publicly.
beats.reason: Untaught musical potential is evident. Present as hidden or undeveloped potential, not yet outwardly expressed..

beats.text: Her teacher believed careful lessons could bring out much more.
beats.decisive_clue: lessons could develop ability never yet expressed publicly
beats.reason: Lessons could develop ability never yet expressed publicly. Present as hidden or undeveloped potential, not yet outwardly expressed..

chains.feedback_short: Lessons could develop ability never yet expressed publicly makes latent the better fit.
chains.feedback_deep: Latent means present as hidden or undeveloped potential, not yet outwardly expressed; dormant means temporarily inactive after being active, but capable of restarting. Here, lessons could develop ability never yet expressed publicly; that is why latent wins even after the new detail.
chains.contrast_rule: Latent has not yet emerged; dormant has gone quiet for now.
